headline: Kochhar & Co advised Agrawal Infrabuild on submission of ₹1,200 crore resolution plan for Ludhiana Talwandi Toll Roads
sum: Agrawal Infrabuild Private Limited has made a submission of a resolution plan of approximately ₹1,200 crore for Ludhiana Talwandi Toll Roads Private Limited (Corporate Debtor). Kochhar & Co represented and advised Agrawal Infrabuild on…
detail: Agrawal Infrabuild Private Limited has made a submission of a resolution plan of approximately ₹1,200 crore for Ludhiana Talwandi Toll Roads Private Limited (Corporate Debtor). Kochhar & Co represented and advised Agrawal Infrabuild on this transaction. The Firm advised on the Corporate Debtor's overall resolution strategy under the IBC, reviewing the Section 29 information memorandum, the request for resolution plan and evaluation matrix, and the process for submitting, evaluating, and negotiating plans. The team also drafted the resolution plan covering debt restructuring, fund infusion, treatment of creditor classes, and issues arising from the NHAI concession and related arbitration…
